accuracy_gate.policy: no worse than frozen train-mean predictor on identical test cohort

custody: test outputs accessible only to evaluator; not independent new evidence
observation_window: Six complete reactor runs were developed with leave-run-out validation; the 220°C-labelled and calcined-catalyst runs were reserved. All models receive the same fixed 300-minute calibration prefix. The long-term figure duplicated in the source is counted once. No instantaneous conversion or other selectivity enters the predictor.

preprocessing.measurements: inherited native measurements and permitted calibrated features; see source lineage

split.independent_unit: Complete reactor run. Diagnostic forecast after 300 min with fixed prefix calibration; no future conversion/selectivity predictors.
split.policy: deterministic whole independent-unit groups; original confirmation unchanged

stability.scope: diagnostic only; measurement error distribution not independently established
